# Lofton Realty

> Professional real estate services across Houston, Galveston, Austin, and the Gulf Coast.

## Overview

Lofton Realty is a trusted Houston-based real estate broker established in 2006. We specialize in residential and investment properties across Texas, Louisiana, Mississippi, and Florida. Our team provides 24/7 service for buying, selling, and investment advisory.

## Core Services

- **Residential Home Buying & Selling** - Expert guidance for first-time buyers and experienced investors
- **Investment Property Advisory** - Strategic consultation for portfolio growth and market optimization
- **Property Management** - Full-service property oversight and tenant relations
- **Market Analysis & Valuation** - Data-driven insights for informed decision-making

## Service Areas

- Houston, TX (primary market)
- Galveston, TX
- Austin, TX
- Louisiana
- Mississippi
- Florida
